title: Development and mechanistic exploration of a rapid visual fluorescent MIRA-PfAgo assay for the detection of Staphylococcus aureus.
authors: Li, Yulin; Zheng, Min; Li, Yanlin; Chen, Yongyi; Guo, Hua; Dai, Shiyu; Jiang, Yayun; He, Yang
one_liner_zh: 该文开发基于PfAgo的核酸检测方法，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作与分子模拟，但核心是病原检测应用而非TF-DNA结合机制建模，方法可迁移性有限。
abstract: Staphylococcus aureus (S. aureus) is a major pathogen responsible for both clinical and community-acquired infections, and its rapid and specific detection is essential for early infection management. To address the limitations of existing detection methods, such as laborious procedures and dependence on sophisticated instruments, this study coupled the efficient amplification capability of multienzyme isothermal rapid amplification (MIRA) with the sequence-specific DNA cleavage activity of Pyrococcus furiosus Argonaute (PfAgo) and constructed a dual-modal MIRA-PfAgo detection system that enables both real-time fluorescence monitoring and visual result interpretation. This system allows the detection of S. aureus within 1 h, with a limit of detection (LOD) as low as 1 copy/muL. In addition, evaluation using 267 clinical isolates demonstrated an accuracy of 99.63% and a specificity of 100%, highlighting its considerable potential as an efficient and reliable tool for clinical pathogen detection. Furthermore, molecular simulation analysis suggested that, in the Mn(2+)-mediated reaction system, target DNA binding enhanced the overall stability of the PfAgo complex and induced conformational rearrangement of the catalytic center, as well as remodeling of the bimetallic ion coordination environment, thereby enabling precise target DNA recognition and specific cleavage by PfAgo. These results further provide supplementary molecular-level structural support for understanding the molecular basis of efficient and specific PfAgo-based nucleic acid detection.
abstract_zh: 金黄色葡萄球菌（Staphylococcus aureus, S. aureus）是导致临床及社区获得性感染的主要病原体，其快速且特异性的检测对于早期感染管理至关重要。为克服现有检测方法的局限性，如操作繁琐及依赖精密仪器，本研究将多酶恒温快速扩增（multienzyme isothermal rapid amplification, MIRA）的高效扩增能力与火球菌Argonaute（Pyrococcus furiosus Argonaute, PfAgo）的序列特异性DNA切割活性相结合，构建了一种双模态MIRA-PfAgo检测系统，可实现实时荧光监测和可视化结果判读。该系统可在1小时内检测S. aureus，检测限（limit of detection, LOD）低至1拷贝/微升。此外，使用267株临床分离株的评估显示，其准确率为99.63%，特异性为100%，凸显其作为临床病原体检测高效可靠工具的显著潜力。进一步地，分子模拟分析表明，在Mn(2+)介导的反应体系中，靶DNA结合增强了PfAgo复合物的整体稳定性，并诱导催化中心的构象重排，以及双金属离子配位环境的重塑，从而实现PfAgo对靶DNA的精确识别和特异性切割。这些结果进一步为理解基于PfAgo的高效特异性核酸检测的分子基础提供了补充性的分子水平结构支持。
